description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git rebase --abort' functionality and related rebase operations in Git. It defines setup procedures, checks, and various test scenarios for rebasing and aborting rebase states.

methods.name: check_head
methods.description: Checks that the current HEAD is 'pre-rebase' and the current branch is 'to-rebase'.

methods.name: testrebase
methods.description: Runs a series of tests for different rebase options, verifying the behavior of 'git rebase --abort' and related commands under various conditions.
